title: Pure Mudragon
summary: The Mudragon Fusion and Synchro strategy built around Mudragon of the Swamp, Muddy Mudragon, and King of the Swamp, paired with Level 2 Tuners and Dragon Fusion extenders. Both Extra Deck Mudragons bend Fusion rules: Muddy Mudragon substitutes for any named Fusion Material and fuses on the field without a Spell, while Mudragon of the Swamp makes your board untargetable by matching Attributes.

summary.title: Starters
points: Red Resonator Special Summons a Level 4 monster from the hand when Normal Summoned, and Assault Synchron Special Summons itself for 700 LP without using the Normal Summon; either Level 2 Tuner plus a Level 4 makes Level 6 Muddy Mudragon.
Keeper of Dragon Magic discards a card to search Polymerization or Super Polymerization and revives a named Fusion Material in face-down Defense Position.
King of the Swamp discards itself to search Polymerization, or acts as a Fusion Substitute in the hand, field, or GY.

summary.title: Opening: Red Resonator + Keeper of Dragon Magic
steps: Normal Summon Red Resonator and Special Summon Keeper of Dragon Magic from the hand; Keeper discards a card to search Super Polymerization.
Tune Level 2 Red Resonator with Level 4 Keeper of Dragon Magic to Synchro Summon Level 6 Muddy Mudragon.

Send Fallen of Albaz from the Deck to the GY with Albion the Shrouded Dragon to Special Summon Albion from the hand (or use Keeper's revive effect with Polymerization), then activate Muddy Mudragon to fuse itself as Dark Magician with the Dragon Effect Monster into Dark Magician the Dragon Knight.

summary.title: Mudragon of the Swamp & Attribute Shielding
summary.text: Mudragon of the Swamp requires any 2 monsters with the same Attribute and different Types. Once on the field via Instant Fusion, Polymerization, or Super Polymerization, it stops the opponent from targeting it or any monster on the field that shares its Attribute with card effects. Its Quick Effect changes its Attribute to any declared Attribute until the end of the turn, extending targeting protection to DARK bosses like Dark Magician the Dragon Knight or LIGHT bosses like Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Dark Magician the Dragon Knight, fused directly by Muddy Mudragon + any Dragon (Keeper of Dragon Magic, Fallen of Albaz, or Albion the Shrouded Dragon), is treated as Dark Magician and keeps the opponent from targeting or destroying your Spells and Traps. Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon is Forbidden since October 2026.
Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon, made with Muddy Mudragon substituting for Blue-Eyes White Dragon plus a Dragon, is unaffected by Trap Cards and attacks every monster the opponent controls.
Millennium-Eyes Restrict, made with Muddy Mudragon or King of the Swamp plus any Effect Monster, equips and negates opposing monsters when they activate their effects.
Lubellion the Searing Dragon, summoned off Fallen of Albaz, shuffles King of the Swamp and a Dragon from the GY or banishment back into the Deck to Fusion Summon Dark Magician the Dragon Knight.

summary.title: Spells
points: Super Polymerization is an unrespondable Quick-Play breaker that fuses 2 opposing monsters sharing an Attribute and differing in Type straight into Mudragon of the Swamp.

Instant Fusion pays 1000 LP to bring out Level 4 Mudragon of the Swamp or Level 1 Millennium-Eyes Restrict; Mudragon of the Swamp can then tune with Red Resonator or Assault Synchron into Muddy Mudragon.
Polymerization fuses King of the Swamp or Beastking of the Swamps from the hand or field into any named-material Fusion boss.

main: King of the Swamp
The Main Deck form of Mudragon: substitutes for any 1 named Fusion Material on a Fusion Monster, OR discards itself from your hand to add 1 'Polymerization' from your Deck to your hand.
Beastking of the Swamps
Level 4 WATER Aqua Fusion Substitute monster that pairs with Level 2 Tuners for Level 6 Muddy Mudragon or substitutes for any named Fusion Material.
Red Resonator
Level 2 Tuner that Special Summons a Level 4 monster from your hand on Normal Summon (2 + 4 = Level 6 Muddy Mudragon!) and gains LP when Special Summoned.
Assault Synchron
Level 2 DARK Tuner that Special Summons itself from your hand without using your Normal Summon, tuning with any Level 4 into Level 6 Muddy Mudragon!
Keeper of Dragon Magic

Level 4 DARK Dragon: searches Polymerization or Super Polymerization on Summon, tunes with a Level 2 Tuner into Muddy Mudragon, OR fuses ON THE FIELD with Muddy Mudragon into Dark Magician the Dragon Knight!
Fallen of Albaz
Level 4 DARK Dragon: fuses with an opponent's monster into Lubellion or Mudragon of the Swamp, OR fuses on the field with Muddy Mudragon into Dark Magician the Dragon Knight.
Albion the Shrouded Dragon
Level 8 DARK Dragon: sends Fallen of Albaz from Deck to GY to Special Summon itself from hand—giving you the Dragon Effect Monster on field for Muddy Mudragon!
Super Polymerization
Unrespondable Quick-Play Spell that fuses 2 of your opponent's monsters into Mudragon of the Swamp.
Polymerization
Searched by King of the Swamp and Keeper of Dragon Magic to fuse King of the Swamp or Mudragon into Fusion bosses.
Instant Fusion

Limited to 1 in TCG: Special Summons Level 4 Mudragon of the Swamp from the Extra Deck—and tuning Level 2 Red Resonator/Assault Synchron + Level 4 Mudragon of the Swamp Synchro Summons Level 6 Muddy Mudragon!
